status: Specified before Barcelona candidate fitting or final-test access
inclusion: All technically usable complete laps. Participant identity, dates, absolute chronology and old independence flags do not exclude laps. Supported optional steering/gear channels may be absent and use training-only imputation. Preserve all legitimate fast/slow laps.
targets: Existing counter/current timer/witnessed next-counter Last Lap Time, LDX beacons, countdown and progress checks. Permit at most 1 ms negative final-timer difference solely for source field rounding; all 50 ms beacon/export/target and other boundary checks remain. Never infer an unwitnessed tail or manufacture a missing beacon.
duplicates: Drop exact raw-capture or full canonical-lap duplicates with matching verified target. Retain nonidentical trajectories; matching coarse signatures with consistent targets link recording groups as possible related exports, rather than becoming independently split samples.
groups: Keep stints in each explicit source recording folder together. The XX folder is a mixed-date/unknown-participant collection; each actual LD capture is a group, unless duplicate/overlap evidence links captures. Never merge groups merely for matching/unknown driver codes. These are recording blocks, not certified independent physical sessions.

split.minimum: Only nonempty train/validation/test populations required. No driver or arbitrary session-count gate. All prefixes of a lap and all laps of a recording block stay together.

chronology_claim: Offline retrospective recording-block holdout. Source absolute chronology/unknown links are imperfect; do not claim unseen-session, unseen-driver or prospective chronological generalization.
models: Unchanged make_models: Ridge alpha=10; RF 120 trees, depth=6, leaf=2, seed=42; RBF SVR C=10, epsilon=0.5. No hyperparameter search.
baseline_historical_median: Median of unique permitted TRAIN lap targets, available as a frozen offline pretraining reference. No held-out target updates and no claim of absolute capture chronology.
baseline_previous_lap: Only a witnessed earlier training lap of the same capture, or a uniquely identifiable earlier training capture with supported date. Ambiguous same-day last-capture order or date-conflict sources produce unavailable, not an invented prior lap. Report matched coverage.
experiment_A: Default: every technically valid training lap.
experiment_B: Only if the pre-fit audit finds a concrete timing-quality category: complete valid laps whose maximum positive source lap-timer step exceeds 100 ms (within the accepted 200 ms ceiling). Exclude that category from TRAIN only; same fixed inclusive validation/test populations and model configurations. Metadata uncertainty/slow lap times are not quality filters. If no such category exists in training, do not invent a filtering experiment.
filter_adoption: Prefer A unless B improves validation MAE by both at least 0.5 s and 5% for at least two of the three models, also improves recording-macro MAE, and does not worsen slow-band validation MAE by more than 0.5 s. Repeat a potentially adopted candidate on train/validation only to verify determinism. Test remains unopened.
learning_curve: Same fixed configurations on nested seeded training-recording populations at approximately 50%, 75%, 100%; same inclusive validation laps. Training-only preprocessing; report train/validation, slow-band and recording-macro errors. No test metric used.
pace_bands: Q25/Q75 from unique full TRAIN lap targets; never remove difficult held-out laps.
final_test: After A/B decision and validation selection are saved, evaluate the selected model once on frozen test blocks. Other candidates have validation results only. Repeated commands verify/reuse frozen evaluation; missing local models may be rebuilt from TRAIN without re-evaluating test.
uncertainty: Report recording-block errors/ranges and repeated-prefix clustering explicitly. Unknown capture links limit inferential independence; do not present narrow prefix-based confidence intervals.
artifacts: Dedicated artifacts/barcelona_v071/models namespace; signed local bundles, domain/schema/units/feature/protocol/corpus identity checks. Never overwrite v0.6/v0.7 artifacts or audit files.
